summary: One church, no schedule box: weekend and weekday Masses come from three weeks of intentions in two bulletins and match the website. Weekday Mass and Wednesday Exposition are in the Parish Center's Holy Family Chapel on the church grounds. Saturday Confession and the Thanksgiving and Immaculate Conception Masses come from the parish website (R6). No open questions.
